name: Crystal Satana
source:
Torta, a village girl, lives a peaceful life in the village of Christi, known as the "Village of Purity."
But one day, the demon organization "Crystal◇Hunts" comes to the village, targeting Torta.
To keep everyone safe, Torta decides to leave the village...
